eps.o: Hondo Harrelson gets one shot at redemption: build an S.W.A.T. unit from LA's overlooked talent; the team clicks under fire, but one of Hondo's own made a promise that has nothing to do with protecting S.W.A.T.

When the Exiles descend on a family business, a father-son power struggle boils over into a hostage standoff with deeper roots than turf; taking point as Scout for the first time, Malik faces an impossible call: one that will haunt him and the squad.

A manhunt pushes the Exiles to their breaking point; when a decision Hondo made to shield his squad from scrutiny comes back to bite him, he realizes someone close to him may know more than they're letting on.

Called to account for a mission gone sideways, Hondo and the Exiles are forced to relive a hostage rescue disguised as an ICE raid; as the board digs for answers, Hondo uncovers footage that changes everything he thought he knew about his own squad.

When a foreign dignitary is targeted in a hit hidden inside a protest scheme, the Exiles race to identify the real threat; as a shocking murder causes chaos, Malik's growing web of secrets puts him on a collision course with the rest of the team.

When the FBI comes calling, Jude is pulled back undercover to infiltrate a white supremacist crew he spent years with; as his true history comes to light, the Exiles must reckon with what he did to survive and whether they can still trust him.
